author: SwoleFeraligatr
quote: Masterpiece of both a title and remake. This game gave me goosebumps revisiting areas from the original game while paired with a beautiful original soundtrack. It was enjoyable to play the ocarina and the attention to detail that went with playing it was appreciated! The game has all of the original floors and rooms from the 1998 game. It's the perfect game to play as your introduction into the Zelda series! Gameplay 10/10 Story 10/10
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: SwoleFeraligatr
quote: What a huge disappointment. It's the opposite of what we expect from a GTA game. The dev team explains a lot about the weak storyline and restrictions put into the game. It's modern slop along with the writers trying to push a political agenda. Both characters are extremely unlikable. Not expecting a lot from the franchise anymore.
